lock_mode_before_rebase.meaning: lockMode field value stored before rebaseOraclePack executes

lock_mode_after_rebase.meaning: lockMode field value stored after rebaseOraclePack executes

assumptions: The lockMode field is a 2-bit value stored in the OraclePack; its prior value is whatever was stored before rebaseOraclePack runs.

unresolved.description: Report does not state the exact prior lockMode value in the general case (only that the guardian sets it to '3' in one scenario), so the expected preserved value is symbolic rather than a fixed literal.

limitations: No frozen precondition sources were selected; the claim is conditioned only on rebaseOraclePack having executed.
The '00' encoding of the cleared 2-bit lockMode is represented by the symbolic after-value rather than a fixed literal, since the report does not bind the prior value generally.
